answer: Voting weight is earned only by waiting, and siblings wait quadratically longer. The nadir is a registry that sinks identities sharing a funder, host or code fingerprint into one cluster. A gale, one claimed identity ranked k-th in its cluster, votes only after banking k² velvet, one epoch of peer-attested live work. An honest gale waits 1 epoch. Running clones in parallel still leaves the 100th clone 10,000 epochs from voting. Colluding attestors, or clones dodging the nadir's clustering, break it.
